title: Async score processor resources use production-safe lifecycle defaults
description:
As a platform operator, I want reusable async score processor resources to use retry-safe queue visibility and explicit retained logging, so that downstream deployments do not duplicate work or silently lose operational history.

Feature: Production-safe async score processor resources

Scenario: Queue visibility covers worker execution
Given an async score processor Lambda has a configured timeout
When its request and response queues are created
Then each queue visibility timeout is at least six times the worker timeout

Scenario: Runtime logs have an explicit lifecycle
Given an async score processor Lambda is deployed
When its log group is synthesized
Then the log group has explicit retention and a retained removal policy

Scenario: Queue data survives stack replacement
Given an async score processing stack owns request, response, and dead-letter queues
When the stack is replaced or deleted
Then the queues are retained by default
